# Reviewed development candidate

`hollis-labs-plugin-host-ui-0.1.0.tgz` is an unpublished development candidate, built from Hollis Labs design-kit commit `dbcf4fa7f5bcfe83686d227b39ddf9426cea4fe5`, package `packages/plugin-host-ui`. MIT license is included in the archive. The source checkout was read-only. A repo-local copy received a standalone TypeScript config replacing workspace inheritance; runtime source bytes were unchanged.

SHA-256: `360c4bd74df7369d57af74151bba0ff0739b31b5c67499f1c01c15cefb4b24b0`.

The archive is intentionally committed for reproducible installs; it is not an npm release. Candidate source and build output are ignored. `frontend/src/chimera` preserves the typed integration example authored by Chimera in this session (MIT), from `frontend/src/{runtime,store,actions}` at Chimera commit `e8327a939965` and new `{composition,fixture-actions}` at `c6485d234afe2fb004feb7d4ff7fc55e631f3217` (format-only local changes). `example.ts` is Parallax-owned policy specialized from these adapters; these copied TS integration sources are app-specialized with controlled scenario context and are not a published npm package, with app-owned region/isolation/action policy.

## Released communications dependencies

No communications snapshot was packed. The npm lockfile pins released `@hollis-labs/kit-chat@0.4.0` (MIT AND Apache-2.0; registry SHA-1 `347ace2d3481b2d8f48dc3f77d36c4988c9f0414`, integrity `sha512-eM6ePb/S9KSRyaq2DUKvC2ukwaFusGbKkTBn/GEAuLMfc/IrSeAmU7DbMte1hKQC2Aoll2bDrhrnO1k0hJgmwg==`) and `@hollis-labs/design-bindings@0.1.0` (MIT; SHA-1 `684eade4af87022bd7875cdc5b64b4d00891a830`, integrity `sha512-tRRNruWnm+4Apg0Gdjaqb2KXyvl0QyevtuUKxsHKlZ2/ittyaMKaWy5lEsfQpQrG8tzwAURlV/UnPvU8z5YJog==`). Registry metadata and committed design-kit APIs were reviewed; design-kit remains untouched. The full released chat LICENSE, including upstream attribution and Apache terms, is copied verbatim into frontend/public/kit-chat-LICENSE.txt and included in built app/Storybook assets. The bindings license remains in the installed npm package.

## Reviewed account development candidate

`hollis-labs-kit-account-0.0.0.tgz` is the private unpublished MIT `packages/kit-account` source at design-kit commit `dbcf4fa7f5bcfe83686d227b39ddf9426cea4fe5`. SHA-256 `3c69fd3041bb4a2d040d8b5d46ba9d5a26028388ee35030ff6d93deabc951e7f`. Source was copied into this repository's ignored scratch directory and built against existing design-components/tokens0.4.0, React19 and Vite7.3.6; no upstream builds or edits occurred. Standalone declaration/Vite configuration replaced workspace inheritance; package scripts were removed for isolated packing. Runtime source bytes, source.css and MIT license remain unchanged. `kit-account-provenance.json` records original source checksums and the adaptations. The archive is committed for reproducible installs, not published. Full MIT text also ships as frontend/public/kit-account-LICENSE.txt. Its source README mentions an older primitives pairing; current0.4.0 compatibility is proven by this consumer's type/build/browser checks.

The optional `frontend/src/chimera/admin-session.ts` lifetime adapter is authored MIT Chimera source from commit `f3b1d5978c40d5b219ad3256581f9d4c2c67e71c` (format-only local changes). It fences synchronous local presentation commits by context/source/channel; it owns no transport or backend effects. AdminContent/SettingsDraft/Wizard projections remain exact released kit contracts. App-owned fixture validation, canonical destinations and draft/read policy remain in Parallax.
